body:
## Summary

Introduce the **Phase 2 independent PR-review procedure** as a repository-local `decent-review` skill, with entry points in `AGENTS.md`, `doc/AI_REPO_MAP.md`, and a Claude Code discovery forwarder, plus a G4 cross-reference in `doc/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`.

The skill covers: verifying against accepted issues and actual patches, risk classification, acceptance-to-evidence mapping, SHA-specific findings, evidence and device limitations, first reviews, post-push delta reviews, review publication boundaries and pilot measurement. It does **not** authorize automatic approval, merge or hardware use.

This PR delivers the **reviewer skill**, not the three-PR pilot; issue #1204 must remain open until the pilot is documented.

## Linked Issue

Related #1204 (do not auto-close; three L1/L2/L3 pilot reviews and a delta review remain).

## Risk and Acceptance Criteria

- **Risk level:** L0 — documentation/agent instructions only, with no runtime, API, CI enforcement or branch-protection change.
- **Why this level:** Five Markdown files; only a new skill, a Claude Code forwarder, and links into existing guidance.

| Issue acceptance criterion | Status (verified / not tested / blocked) | Test, scenario or artifact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reviewer can start from PR and linked issue with no conversation context | verified (documented) | Skill “First review procedure” requires head SHA, linked issue/body/comments, diff, CI, prior threads and architecture |
| Report includes reviewed SHA, risk, criteria and evidence gaps | verified (documented) | Skill “Record findings and a decision-ready verdict” includes a complete report skeleton |
| Post-push delta review checks changed SHA and regressions | verified (documented) | Skill “Delta review after a new push” |
| Recognize human/hardware validation limits | verified (documented) | Independent reviewer rules and evidence-validation sections |
| Tool-agnostic and independent; no automatic approval/merge | verified (documented) | Skill frontmatter, rules and publication section; Claude Code forwarder preserves the canonical location |
| Pilot covers L1/L2/L3 and a real delta review | not tested | Separate Phase 2 pilot remains open in #1204 |
| Phase 3 recommendations based on measured pilot results | not tested | Deferred until pilot data exists |

## Verification

- **Verified commit SHA:** `2088423b488619274c564cefc25f359124ed8f15` (updated branch content inspected at this SHA after review fixes).
- **Environment:** GitHub repository content API / documentation review. No local checkout or physical device.
- **Commands and results:** Retrieved and inspected all five changed Markdown files on the branch; checked skill YAML frontmatter/name, canonical reviewer-table consistency (two matching uses), verdict vocabulary, worktree-baseline guidance, Claude Code forwarder and repo-map routing, and absence of merge-conflict markers. No local Flutter test/analyze or CI result is claimed; hosted CI is reported separately from any author-run checks.
- **Running-app or API scenario:** N/A — no app behavior changed.
- **Captures or traces:** N/A — L0 nonvisual.
- **Negative paths and regression checks:** Procedure explicitly covers stale tested SHA, missing physical evidence, untrusted author summaries, unresolved threads, reviewer self-review, and changed contracts requiring full re-review.
- **Not tested / limitations / human validation needed:** Hosted CI for the updated head and live three-PR pilot remain unverified at this revision; earlier-head CI is not equivalent. Existing `AGENTS.md` verification requirements still apply. Reviewer/maintainer should check hosted CI and trial usability. No reviews have been posted as part of the pilot.

## Independent review feedback addressed

- Unified the criterion table used by the review procedure and report; the author-facing PR template remains distinct and canonical for PR authors.
- Aligned G4 verdict wording with the reviewer skill; reconciled author (`verified/not tested/blocked`) and reviewer (`verified/weak/not tested/blocked`) statuses.
- Added the missing fresh-worktree/untracked-asset and stale-bundle diagnosis guard.
- Added Claude Code skill discovery and the repo-map routing row.
- Contributor Responsibility remains unchecked pending confirmation by the human submitter; this is not a claim of review or acceptance on their behalf.

## Impact

Documentation/agent-review process only. No user-visible behavior, persistent data, API/schema contract, mandatory status check or merge-policy change. Phase 1 advisory evidence requirements remain advisory.

## Contributor Responsibility

AI-assisted development is allowed. The submitter remains responsible for the submitted work.

- [x] I have reviewed and understand all changes in this PR and take responsibility for their correctness, security, behavior, licensing, and provenance, including any AI-assisted or AI-generated work. <!-- contributor-responsibility -->
